title: Storytelling
learning_outcomes: Explain narrative purpose in the context of storytelling.
Compare and distinguish sequence and stakes in the context of storytelling.
Apply concrete detail in the context of storytelling.
Evaluate and justify decisions about feedback in the context of storytelling.

lessons.title: Narrative purpose
lessons.outcome: Explain narrative purpose in the context of storytelling.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving narrative purpose; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to original story.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain narrative purpose from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of narrative purpose; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Sequence and stakes
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish sequence and stakes in the context of storytelling.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving sequence and stakes; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to original story.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain sequence and stakes from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of sequence and stakes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Concrete detail
lessons.outcome: Apply concrete detail in the context of storytelling.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving concrete detail; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to original story.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain concrete detail from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of concrete detail; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Feedback
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about feedback in the context of storytelling.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving feedback; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to original story.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain feedback from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of narrative purpose; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of sequence and stakes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of concrete detail; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
